svg.title: BART reconstructs whole text; T5 reconstructs masked spans
svg.desc: BART corrupts an input and trains its encoder-decoder to reconstruct the entire clean sequence. T5 replaces spans with unique sentinel tokens and trains the decoder to output only the missing spans.

g.text: BART reconstructs whole text; T5 reconstructs masked spans
Both use encoder–decoder Transformers, but their corruption targets differ.
